rules.name: Temperamental Transformation
rules.description:
Each time this fighter activates, at the end of its activation it must pass a Willpower test else the *transformation* ends.
When the transformation ends, remove this fighter from the battlefield then set up the Lycanfell Noble at the same location (or as close to it as possible). Any damage the Lycanfell Beast has suffered, the Lycanfell Noble has also suffered. If this would reduce the Lycanfell Noble to zero life, they are taken down.

rules.name: Vestiges of the Noble
rules.description:
While this fighter is on the battlefield, it is treated as a new fighter that is added to the warband. It has none of the Lycanfell Noble’s Wargear, Skills or Injuries etc. If the Lycanfell Noble was under the effects of a spell or another rule, this fighter is not affected. In addition, the following rules
apply:
- **Scenarios**: If the scenario gave the Lycanfell Noble a mark (such as being the ‘Hit’ in Street of Death), this fighter has that mark.
- **Treasure**: If the Lycanfell Noble was carrying treasure when it transformed, this fighter is carrying the treasure. Likewise, if this fighter is
carrying treasure when the transformation ends, the Lycanfell Noble is now carrying that treasure.
- **Taken Down**: If this fighter is taken down, the Lycanfell Noble is also taken down, (together they count as 1 for the purposes of Flee Tests).
- **Experience**: Any bonus experience this fighter would have earned is granted to the Lycanfell Noble instead.

rules.name: Cloud of Bats
rules.description:
Once per battle, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Cloud of Bats [Bonus Action]**: Remove the fighter from the battlefield, set them up again anywhere on the battlefield, wholly within 9" horizontally of their previous location. They cannot be set up engaged in melee.

rules.name: Mesmeric Gaze
rules.description: Once per battle, when this fighter makes a Melee Attack action, it can attempt to *mesmerise* the defending fighter. If they do so, the commanding players each roll a dice and add their fighter’s Willpower value to the score. If this fighter’s total exceeds the defending fighter’s total, they are *mesmerised* for that action. While they are *mesmerised*, subtract 1 from the Attacks value of their melee weapons (off-hand attacks are not affected).

rules.name: Unholy Strength
rules.description: This fighters melee weapons gain the Bludgeon weapon trait.

rules.name: Supernatural Healing
rules.description: This fighter cannot suffer permanent injuries. If they suffer a lasting injury it is always temporary. In addition, if this fighter is killed. You can immediately make a Willpower test for them. If passed, they are not killed but must miss the next d3 battles as they slumber. Pick a Champion in your warband to be the Leader in their absence. That fighter temporarily gains the *Leader* keyword and loses the *Champion* keyword until the Leader returns.

rules.name: Leech Blood
rules.description:
Once per battle, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Leech Blood [Bonus Action]**: Each enemy fighter within 9" of this fighter must take a Willpower test. If they fail, they suffer 1 damage and this fighter heals 1 life.

rules.name: Relentless Attacker
rules.description: Subtract 1 from parry rolls made against attacks made by this fighter.

rules.name: Death March
rules.description:
Once per battle, this fighter can use the following bonus action:
**Death March [Bonus Action]**: Until the end of the round, add 2 to the Move value of friendly *Thralls* who begin a move while they are within 9" of this fighter.

rules.name: Rise Again
rules.description:
When this fighter is taken down for the first time in battle, mark its location with a token. At the start of each subsequent round you can roll a dice, on a 6 the fighter returns.
If the fighter returns, set them up on the battlefield as close to the marked location as possible. They heal d3 life points. A fighter can only return once per battle in this manner.

rules.name: Chill Touch
rules.description: Add 1 to the Critical Damage value of this fighter’s melee weapons.

rules.name: Dread Aura
rules.description:
This fighter *causes fear*. Enemy fighters that start their activation engaged in melee with a fighter that causes fear must pass a Willpower test. If they fail, their activation immediately ends.
Enemy fighters that also cause fear can ignore this rule.

rules.name: Drag Down Into the Earth
rules.description: When this fighter is taken down while engaged in melee, pick 1 fighter it is engaged with, they suffer d3 damage.

rules.name: Kingsguard
rules.description:
This skill can only be picked for a *Champion*.
If an enemy fighter finishes a Charge Move engaged in melee with a friendly Leader, and this fighter is not engaged, this fighter can make a Charge Move. This fighter must finish that Charge Move engaged in melee
with that enemy fighter. If it does so, the enemy fighter must target this fighter with any melee attack actions it makes this activation.
